protocolDescription: Focused model-only extraction: medicines, followUps/appointments, highlights, per source chunk. Greedy Metal,4096 context,1536/1024/768 token limits. No source recovery; validators only reject candidates. Raw facts and accepted facts are separate. Exact-field scoring is not clinical validation. Development results are not held-out results. Dataset role and description: Second development trial: evidence-first medication output, explicit current-source boundary, and clearer follow-up versus appointment prompts. Used for prompt selection; not held out.
